description: Compute upcoming Gregorian dates for yahrzeits, Hebrew birthdays or Hebrew anniversaries from the original Gregorian date. Handles after-sunset, Adar in leap years, and Cheshvan/Kislev edge cases. Up to 10 entries at once.

date.description: Original Gregorian date YYYY-MM-DD (date of passing, birth or wedding).

name.description: Name of the person or event.

years.description: How many years ahead to list.

name: get_yahrzeit_dates
title: Yahrzeit, Hebrew birthday & anniversary dates
